- [EVENT] User is trying to decide between Costa Rica and Iceland for summer vacation.
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in weather information for both Costa Rica and Iceland in August.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Costa Rica in August is part of the "green season," with daytime temperatures ranging from 77°F (25°C) to 87°F (31°C) along the coast and nighttime temperatures around 65°F (18°C) in the mountains.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] August in Costa Rica has an average of 12 rainy days, with short rain showers followed by sunshine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Humidity in Costa Rica is relatively high, especially in coastal regions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of Costa Rica in August include lush landscapes, fewer tourists, and lower prices; cons include muddy roads and occasional rain showers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Iceland in August is summer, with average high temperatures ranging from 50°F (10°C) to 60°F (16°C) during the day and nighttime temperatures dropping to around 40°F (4°C) to 50°F (10°C).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] August in Iceland has an average of 9 rainy days and almost 24 hours of daylight, with the midnight sun still visible.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of Iceland in August include mild temperatures, long days, and a higher chance of seeing the Northern Lights; cons include peak tourist season, higher prices, and larger crowds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider their preference for warmer weather and tropical climate versus unique rugged landscapes and the chance to see the Northern Lights when deciding between Costa Rica and Iceland.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User is interested in outdoor activities and things to do in Costa Rica, such as hiking and wildlife watching.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Top hiking locations in Costa Rica include Corcovado National Park, Arenal Volcano, and Monteverde Cloud Forest.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wildlife watching opportunities in Costa Rica include Tortuguero National Park, Manuel Antonio National Park, and Osa Peninsula.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other outdoor activities in Costa Rica include surfing, whitewater rafting, zip lining, visiting hot springs and waterfalls, and birdwatching.
